numbering: Physical PDF and printed pages agree; top vertices numbered x1,x2,... from left to right, bottom vertices y1,y2,... from left to right.

odd.locator: Theorem4.8, physical page12; seed4.7 physical page11
odd.parameters: r odd>=7, m=4k+6, n=2r+1+4k; k>=1 for4.8, k=0 for retained4.7
odd.top_path: edges x_j--x_(j+1) have labels 0,1,0/2 followed by 2k repeated pairs 1,0, then 1,2,3,...,r-1
odd.vertical_edges: last two corresponding top/bottom pairs have label r-3
odd.cap_mapping: coordinate i^+ is x_(m+i-1), i^- is y_i, t=r-2; two leaves are x_(m-1), x_(m-2)

even.top_path: odd list followed by one last edge labelled r-2
even.vertical_edges: last four corresponding pairs have label r-4
even.cap_mapping: coordinate i^+ is x_(m+i-1), i^- is y_i, t=r-1; two leaves x_(m-1),x_(m-2)
even.deletion_map: After omitting label r-1, remove last two top and last two bottom vertices. Remaining labels0..r-2 give HighOdd(r-1,k). Removed square has labels r-4 vertical and r-2 horizontal.

retained_seed.precise_obligation: For every odd q>=7, the literal HighOdd(q,0) marking is a string C-marking generating A_(2q+1).
retained_seed.attributed_source: M.E.Fernandes, D.Leemans, M.Mixer, All alternating groups A_n with n>=12 have polytopes of rank floor((n-1)/2), SIAM J.Discrete Math26(2)(2012),482-498
retained_seed.not_claimed: No new proof of this prior seed or access to its original full text is claimed. It is an explicit retained theorem input, not the principal result being recovered.

computational_source_models: families.g is an exact transcription for reproducibility. Larger-degree samples are diagnostics, not proof premises.
